{{Attr|Splash}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ghost''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. While the '''Ghost''' had half the health of the [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]] and an average speed, the '''Ghost''' was a far more dangerous threat because it was a hidden enemy. It also could not be burnt or hit by splash damage. As it was a ghost enemy, it could not collide with [[units]]. All these factors made the '''Ghost''' a challenge to kill without the right towers. The '''Ghost''' could also be spawned by [[Lord Sinister]]. ==Appearance== The '''Ghost's''' body was glowing white and was translucent. It had the {{RLinkC|12467159|Ghostface}} as its face. It floated a small distance above the path and emitted light. ==Strategy== *[[Military Base]] [[units]] are ineffective against the '''Ghost''', as they pass through the [[units]]. *Make sure to have hidden detection by wave 6, as four '''Ghosts''' will spawn. **The most effective towers for this are [[Militant]]s, [[Shotgunner]]s or [[Minigunner]]s. **Several Level 3+ [[Minigunner]]s are probably your best bet against this enemy. **[[Accelerator]]s can also be used to kill '''Ghosts'''. *The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability is effective if towers have hidden detection, but the [[Commander]] itself will not attack the '''Ghost'''. *Even if the '''Ghost''' is caught in an explosion, it will not be dealt any damage due to its [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. *The [[Pyromancer]] cannot burn the '''Ghost''', even if a detectable enemy is beside the '''Ghost'''. However, the '''Ghost''' can still be dealt non-burn damage by the [[Pyromancer]]. *The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Frost Blaster]] can slow down the '''Ghost''', so long they have hidden detection. ==Trivia== *In terms of appearance and immunities, the [[Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)|2019]] and 2020 '''Ghost''' were very similar. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Ghost''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Ghost''' removed. {{TrickTown|[[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]]|Wave 5|Ghost|Wave 6|[[Buried]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Ghost}}
